'''Blake Senn'''<ref name="dt-8597">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/8597 Dark Machinery of Fate], DeckTech (Blake "Zurai" Senn, 21 July 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/8597/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/8597/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018150741/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/8597/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''Zurai''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|Ralltiir Operations]] list on DeckTech in July 2000.
